_source: Hand-verified from ASX Appendix 4D (Ramelius Resources, Dec 2025 half-year). All values AUD, scale=thousands applied.

notes.ebit: Confirmed from Appendix 4D highlights: EBIT 31,284 (000). Cross-check: PBT 40,607 + finance_costs 5,849 - interest_income 15,172 = 31,284.
notes.np_attributable: Net loss for the half-year. Acquisition-related costs ($133.2M stamp duty) and royalty obligation FV adjustment ($46.6M) depressed result.
notes.capex: PP&E payments only from investing activities. Mine development payments (83,614) excluded as they are typically reported separately.
notes.net_debt: RMS has no formal debt. Only lease liabilities (87,994,000 total). Net debt concept unclear — marked null.
notes.shares_outstanding: From Note 14: 1,924,937,480 ordinary shares at 31 Dec 2025, post Spartan acquisition (752,904,179 shares issued).
